title: Ford Falcon Engines by Year (1960–1970)
description: Every factory engine in the Ford Falcon by year, 1960–1970: the 144, 170 and 200 sixes, the 260 and 289 V8s, the 302 and the 1970½ 429 Cobra Jet.
intro: The Falcon was Ford's compact from 1960 to 1970. It began with a 144 cubic-inch six and added V8s in 1963 with the Sprint. In its last months the name went onto a low-priced Torino-based 1970½ model that could be ordered with a 429.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The first Falcons used the 144 and 170 sixes; the 260 V8 arrived in early 1963 with the Sprint, and the 289 replaced it for 1965.
The second Falcon used Ford's sixes and small blocks through 1970. The 1970½ Falcon was a low-priced Torino with that car's engines, up to the 429 Cobra Jet; the notes mark its rows.
